examples.quote: Replay the complete previous density-by-threshold-by-food-by-founder-age experiment, using its 100 archived source panels and all 14,400 mixture and monoculture simulations. An isolated Julia research hook observes each grass bite during agent update. Record births by parent policy and age, deaths by individual policy and age, grass intake by consumer policy and age, and pre-mortality exposure in agent-ticks in age bands 0–49, 50–99, 100–149 and 150+. Track inheritance by exact haploid policy mean with mutation disabled. An individual's age is its age after that tick's increment. Newborns enter exposure at the next tick.
